label: دراسات  ·  02
title: الحديد والمزاج
subtitle: يخفف الأعراض… ما يغني عن العلاج
source: Gordon B.R. et al., JAMA Psychiatry, 2018

evidence.design: meta-analysis of 33 randomized clinical trials, 1,877 participants
evidence.finding: resistance training reduced depressive symptoms, delta 0.66 (95% CI 0.48-0.83), regardless of health status, prescribed volume or whether strength improved; smaller effect in blinded trials (0.56); authors: alternative and/or adjuvant therapy
